integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Platform-wide OAuth credentials for connector integrations. Each end user connects their own account; these are the keys the OAuth flow uses on their behalf.
integrations.googleDescription: One OAuth client covers both. Used when a user clicks 'Connect' on Google Calendar or Google Sheets in Settings.
integrations.hubspotDescription: Used when a user clicks 'Connect HubSpot' in Settings → Integrations.
integrations.slackDescription: Used when a user clicks 'Add to Slack' in Settings → Integrations.
integrations.callbackHint: Leave blank to auto-detect from the incoming request. Set explicitly when running behind a proxy that breaks request host detection. Must exactly match the redirect URL configured in the provider's app dashboard.
integrations.redirectUrisHint: Add both of these to your OAuth client in Google Cloud Console → Credentials → Authorized redirect URIs. Google rejects the sign-in if they do not match exactly.
integrations.hubspotLegacyNotice: HubSpot closed new public app registrations on 23 June 2026, so these fields only apply if you registered an app before then. New connections use a service key instead — each user pastes one from their own HubSpot account under Settings → Integrations.

branding.description: Customize your platform's identity. Changes apply across the entire application.

branding.logoDarkHint: Logo shown in dark mode (light-colored logo). PNG, SVG recommended.
